insights.title: Undersupplied Quality Tier in 1000-1499 Band
insights.observation: 6 listings observed in the 1000-1499 band with a high average rating of 4.22 ★.
insights.hypothesis: Buyers show high satisfaction in 1000-1499, but seller concentration is low (18.8% of catalog).
insights.evidence: n=6 listings with average rating 4.22 ★ vs market median 4.25 ★.
insights.limitations: Low listing counts may indicate low shopper query volume rather than unmet demand.

standing_limitations: Market metrics reflect a point-in-time public listing snapshot.
Non-random sample of active listings; variants are counted as separate rows.
Review ratings reflect self-selected customer sentiment, not verified purchase rates.
Review counts represent cumulative customer attention, not current unit sales or revenue.
